title: Arc Movement Studios NZ Deals & Promotions – September 2026
meta_desc: Discover September 2026 offers at Arc Movement Studios Kelburn – pricing, fee waivers, Exercise NZ subsidy comparison and tips to secure the best deal.
intro: Arc Movement Studios in Kelburn offers boutique Pilates and yoga with tiny class sizes and no lock‑in contracts. This guide breaks down the September 2026 promotions, how to claim them and how to stretch your dollars further, including the Exercise NZ subsidy.

sections.heading: Current Promotions – What’s on the Table
sections.body: For September 2026 Arc Movement Studios runs an introductory package for new students: 2 weeks of unlimited classes for $15 (normally $25) plus a complimentary physiotherapy consultation worth $80. Regular pricing remains $25–$55 per week depending on class type, with no joining fee. The offer is only available online and must be redeemed within the first two weeks of enrolment.
list: No joining fee for new members

sections.heading: How to Claim & Best Time of Year to Join
sections.body: To lock in the September intro, visit the studio’s website, select ‘New Student Intro’, and enter the promo code SEPT2026 at checkout. You’ll receive a confirmation email with a QR code to scan on arrival. The studio’s classes fill quickly, so booking at least two weeks ahead is essential. In New Zealand, the post‑holiday period (late August to early September) is when many boutique studios run their strongest promotions, as they aim to fill the summer lull before the new year rush.
list: Book online and use code SEPT2026
Print or save the QR confirmation

sections.heading: Joining Fee – Can It Be Waived?
sections.body: Arc Movement Studios advertises a $0 joining fee year‑round, which is rare for boutique studios. If you’re switching from another provider, the studio will also waive any exit fees from your previous contract, provided you supply proof of termination. This makes the upfront cost essentially just the first week’s membership fee or the intro package price.
list: Exit‑fee waiver if you show proof of previous contract termination

sections.heading: Exercise NZ Subsidy vs Arc’s Pricing
sections.body: Exercise NZ offers a government‑backed subsidy of 40–70 % for eligible members (e.g., unemployed, students, or those inactive for 12+ months). Applying the maximum 70 % subsidy to Arc’s $55/week top tier brings the cost down to $16.50 per week, which is cheaper than the standard $25 introductory rate. However, the subsidy only applies to the standard membership, not to the limited‑time intro package. If you qualify, you can combine the subsidy with Arc’s regular pricing for a long‑term, low‑cost solution.
list: Subsidy not applicable to limited‑time intro offers

sections.heading: 5 Tips to Get the Best Deal at Arc Movement Studios
sections.body: Getting the most value from Arc isn’t just about the price tag; it’s about timing, class selection and leveraging other programmes. Follow these practical tips to stretch every dollar.
list: Sign up during the September intro window – the $15 two‑week unlimited deal is the cheapest entry point.
If you qualify for Exercise NZ, apply the subsidy to the regular membership and switch after the intro period ends.
Book classes in the early morning or late evening slots – these tend to have lower demand and occasional flash discounts.
Combine personal training with group classes – a 5‑session PT package costs $200, which is $40 less than buying sessions individually.
Use the free physiotherapy consult to address any movement limitations early, reducing the risk of injury and the need for extra PT sessions.
